fixture: Locally drawn 1280x800 JPEG visibly marked CONTRACT / NOT OFFICIAL. All official-view APIs were explicitly intercepted; no official verification challenge was accessed.
checks: Official view appears only in verification_required and is removed on cancellation or login success
Fit-width and 150-percent zoom map actual pointer geometry to bounded integer original coordinates in both viewports; zoom scrolls inside its container without page overflow
Primary pointer down/up stays bound to the same frame; consumed UUID and deliberately late old snapshots cannot replay actions
Text input uses password presentation and maxLength 128; send clears local state immediately, does not render or console-log the content, and publishes only text length in test metadata
Only explicit user click/text/Tab/Enter/Backspace/refresh actions are sent; no automatic SMS, answer, input or POST retry
Refresh requires a current available unconsumed frame; image failure can explicitly refresh only while that frame remains valid
Missing frames, read failures and uncertain POST results disable interactions and wait for a fresh loaded UUID; unsafe reflected HTTP errors are not rendered
Safe verification_error guidance appears without treating HTTP receipt as an official action or identity-verification success
Restart during verification explicitly says it abandons verification and starts a new scan
iteration_note: Initial 390px fit mapping failed because legacy MouseEvent rounded a fractional CSS coordinate. PointerEvent preserves it; original tolerance assertions were retained. Failed candidate/geometry diagnostics remain local and were not relabeled as passes.
boundary: This verifies the browser UI and explicitly mocked contracts. It does not prove real SMS delivery, user-entered OTP, real phone identity verification or login completion.
privacy_note: Published reports contain no transient input values, live frames, phone numbers, account details or credentials.
